steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's plugged in.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is it recording? 'Test. Test.'

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Seems all right.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now what should I say?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Closure lent me this device for the purposes of... Well, the application says 'recording self-diagnosis and treatment of trauma using exposure therapy and related methods.'

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: A mouthful indeed.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It is a very simple machine to operate. I just check that the battery is charged, toggle this switch... And now it will record automatically.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Talking to yourself is so difficult.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (I honestly thought it would be easier to just open up to a screen.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: When I asked about alleviating or at least controlling my symptoms, the medical staff suggested this...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: 'Why not try talking it through with yourself...?' They made it sound so easy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Okay, we have video now. Not that I'll be showing this to anyone. Not that I would ever want to show this to anyone.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Calm down, Istina. No need to be nervous. We're all friends here. Just speak your mind. Let it out.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: All those things you've been unable to share with others, you can say to yourself. Over and over again.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's certainly a feasible idea.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So let's take us back...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: While it may seem like there's nothing wrong, I know, sooner or later, we will have to deal with this. With so much.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I know that Gummy and Natalya can never forget those things. What happened in the school... what happened after we left the school... No one could forget.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And Zima, she... I think she has been having nightmares recently. Leto seems like she was able to let it go, but... can someone ever truly let it go?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: As for me? I believe I can face up to it. But can I, actually...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No one will speak of it. But somehow we will have to come to terms with it, in the end.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Still hard.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Phew... all right. I do think I am starting to get used to it though.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Let's begin, for real this time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I suppose I'll introduce myself first?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I am called 'Istina'——This is, of course, a codename. My true name is Anna Morozova.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mmm. It's a name I've not heard in a long time. It is my name, of course, but it feels somewhat unfamiliar. How strange.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: This is Vika. A good friend of mine.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Vika was my best friend before I joined the Student Self-Governing Group.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now I live at the headquarters of an organization called Rhodes Island, where I am classified as part of the 'Ursus Student Self-government Group.'

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mm. This group was my idea, but it was Zima who truly founded it. And while we are indeed independent, at the moment there are only five of us.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Zima, Natalya, Leto, Gummy, and myself.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: There used to be more. But we are the only ones left.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ah, of course, Vika is also a member.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We currently serve as 'Operators' for this Rhodes Island... I suppose it's a kind of job.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I don't mind it. Fair pay for fair work.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Zima has no plans to leave, for the time being. And although she does not speak her mind, I know she is satisfied here. And from time to time, I find myself thinking it would be nice to stay.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Phew.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The truth is, while we're all together now, we did not come from the same school.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, Natalya, and I attended the same high school. Zima and Leto went to another one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh, but Zima was sort of famous, even at our school. In fact, every student in the district knew about her.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I suppose she is something of a born leader. I recognize that she was the right choice to lead us.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Reunion found us defenseless and occupied Chernobog, our city.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then some... things... happened. Reunion took a handful of kids from our school, me among them, and marched us over to Zima's campus.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: There may have been students from other schools there too. I'm not certain. It was a chaotic time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's still not clear why they did it. But it was all orchestrated by the white-haired boy leading that Reunion outfit.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I think he may have been even younger than us? I don't know.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I got the impression he had to convince the other leaders to round up the students, at which point they locked us inside Zima's school.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Looking back now, it all seems ridiculous.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We were locked in there for maybe two weeks, and...
Anna!
Phew! Thank heaven it's you.
Pull me up, Anna.
...Anna?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...and we fought.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We fought within the sealed-up school. And when we managed to escape from it, we fought in the city blocks of Chernobog.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Every one of us has something we must come to terms with.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We——

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (It wouldn't be Gummy this early. Who could it be...?)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Just a minute.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (I think I'll just leave the recording running. I don't want to worry about saving and closing it.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Who is it?
It's me!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Who?
Huh? I'm surprised at you, Junior Detective Istina! How could you not recognize my voice? Are you playing dumb?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Could you keep it down?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And I've told you a thousand times, I'm not your junior detective.
Hah. You two are getting along nicely.
Good afternoon, Anna. I'm here to bother you too.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Tea.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ah, thank you!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Mmm...It smells fantastic. A fine tea indeed!

steps.name: May
steps.text: By the way, you took quite a while to open the door. Are you busy, Istina? Are we interrupting you?

steps.name: May
steps.text: We could always come back later. I really only came to return this book.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm not busy. Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Not with anything pressing anyway.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Relax. If Anna says we're not bothering her, we're not bothering her.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Anna doesn't lie about things like that, now does she?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hehe. Glad to hear it!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, but I never expected you were the type to lock your door. How cautious.

steps.name: May
steps.text: And handy! That kind of caution will serve a junior detective well!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I've been very clear with you that I'm not interested in this junior detective nonsense.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And besides, I just happened to have a reason to lock the door this time.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: But I'd think you are the type to lock your door, actually. Anna's always been the most cautious of us.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't tease me, Natalya.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Heh heh. I just can't help myself with that adorable face of yours.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Anyway, it's quite nice that you take high tea in the afternoon. As it should be!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You really have a thing for tea, huh...? Your face, with that expression, it reminds me of freshly browned toast.

steps.name: May
steps.text: What? What's that supposed to mean?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I suppose it means you look silly.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh? How dare you? That's over the line!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hmph. No matter! Look how magnanimous your senior detective is. I even brought you biscuits!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh? Biscuits? Now that's unexpected...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Is it?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sorry, I didn't expect you to bring snacks. I figured you only came to mooch some tea. I misjudged you.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I'm not some freeloader!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Look, I prepared an extra special thank you gift! With Hibiscus's famous vegetable scones——!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Very good. Let's see you off now. Hurry on back where you came from.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Right now, immediately, through the door and to the right. Have a nice day.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hey now, you needn't be so forceful. The scones are delightful, I promise.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Here, try one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No thank you... Really, stop, I... Don't just shove it in——

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mmmf! Mmmrrfff...!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Ahahahahaha! Now this is what I meant by you two getting along. I'm jealous.

steps.name: Istina & May
steps.text: Utter nonsense. You think we're getting along? / Hehe, like two peas in a pod, eh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Not that we get along poorly, I'd say we just...

steps.name: May
steps.text: I had this all wrong. We don't like each other at all!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Hahahahahaha!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Na- Natalya!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Haha, pffft, hahaha! S- sorry, I just... You two clearly connect on a deeper level than I thought. Pff-hahaha!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Uh.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: There's no way we could be that funny. But whatever... May's here to give back my book. What brings you over, Natalya?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Me? I've had some things on my mind lately. Things I want to talk over with you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh? Important things? That's not like you. Especially to have you come to me.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Hey now, I've always been close to you, Anna.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: But it's really nothing that important. We can come back to it later. Let's enjoy our tea time for now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, let's.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Woah, May! Be careful! Don't go prancing around with your teacup. It'll spill.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I'm not a child! It won't spill.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sorry, I wasn't expecting guests, so the room's a bit messy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: There isn't a good place to entertain guests in the dormitory. But you don't have to stand there, Natalya. Just sit anywhere, like May.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: I'll take you up on that.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: But Rhodes Island does provide nicely furnished dorms. Clean and tidy ones at that.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: You're right that they don't make for good house parties though. Not like we used to have.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Those were more banquets than parties.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh? Banquets?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: What's the difference?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: They're completely different!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Are they?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ooh, a banquet sounds lovely...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Let's not get carried away.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: That was another time. The big house, the lifestyle, none of it has anything to do with who I am now.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: And that Sonya, she always teases me about it. Tactless.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: If it weren't for you, Anna, I'm sure Sonya would be butting heads with everyone left and right.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I honestly think we live quite well right now. It's leagues better than when they had me on undercover investigations.

steps.name: May
steps.text: And by the way, Istina, your room is already very clean. You've got so many books, and they're all so well-organized.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We're still in the midst of setting it all straight. And Gummy's always been rather fastidious.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: That's true. Our Gummy does like to sort things.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Even back in those days, in a place like that, she'd still keep everything we gathered all nicely sorted.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Same as she ever was.

steps.name: May
steps.text: A place like what...?

steps.name: May
steps.text: But a tidy roommate could be great, or I suppose it could be hell.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, and who's this lovely little doll here?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't touch her!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Eep!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Wh- what's the matter? You scared the life out of me.

steps.name: May
steps.text: You didn't have to be so rough.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: My... apologies...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's just, this is something very important to me.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Anna, didn't that belong to...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: So you took the doll with you, you——

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Please stop talking, Natalya.
Stop talking.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm fine. Don't worry.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: ...Anna...
Stop talking.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: I heard about it... what happened back then...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: There was nothing anyone could have done. No one could have known.
Stop talking!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: ...It was tragic. But we all know it wasn't your fault.
Shut up!!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: You were just a second too late. You did all you could.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I know. Thank you. I'm fine, Natalya.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm fine.
I'm fine.
That's what I've always said to everyone.
Zima, Gummy, Leto, Natalya... They all think I'll be fine.
I almost believe it myself.
It wasn't my fault.
Or was it?
I just got there too late.
No, I wasn't late.
I did all I could.
...all I could.
——I'd already made my choice.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ah, this book! Isn't it the last volume of the detective series I've been reading?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm? Oh, that one. Yes, you have a good eye.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: This is the most precious title in the series. The final act in the story of the world's greatest detective... Hmph, I had to beg the Doctor over and over again to help me hunt it down.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, that reminds me... Back in the old country, I saw what I'm pretty sure was a signed copy of the first edition on the bookshelf at home.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh the memories. I cried my eyes out the first time I read it!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Autographed... and a first edition at that...?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh, what rotten luck.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: I remember Sonya saying Anna moved mountains to try to get any signed copy of that author's work. And she's still empty-handed.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: They're just too rare.

steps.name: May
steps.text: (Uh oh. It was that special, was it? There's too much old stuff like that back home. I never noticed!)

steps.name: May
steps.text: Um, err, anyway, Istina. Could you, uh, lend me this book?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...I can. But didn't you say you'd read it before?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Grumbling) A first edition. Signed. Copy?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, well... I did, but it's been so long, you see. It's about time for a reread.

steps.name: May
steps.text: It- it's really quite something that you've got a book like this here. Hahaha, you can read it anytime you like!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: When you put it that way, I suppose I ought to lend it to you. For now.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, Istina, that's marvelous! You're the greatest!

steps.name: May
steps.text: (Phew... No problem there then.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Grumbling) You could stand to be a little more aware of the feelings of others.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Quietly) But nevertheless... thanks.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Did you say something?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, these biscuits are to die for. You really won't have one, Istina?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I didn't say anything.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: They're just normal biscuits, are they? I could have a taste...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But I didn't expect to see you and Natalya together. How do you know one another?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, I wouldn't say we know each other that well. Natalya just happened to lend a hand when I was covertly investigating Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Glad I could help.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You talk about investigating Penguin Logistics quite a bit. Still haven't given up on that, eh?

steps.name: May
steps.text: I'll never give up! I've staked my reputation as a Royal Detective——

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Personally, I think you've long since forfeited your reputation as a Royal Detective.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Why you...! Hmph. I've had just about enough of you!

steps.name: May
steps.text: The point is, we only happened to bump into each other on the way here.

steps.name: May
steps.text: What's more, the last book I borrowed from you was absolutely riveting. I just had to come talk about it as soon as I turned the last page!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, that's not entirely off the table...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's been a while since I had a good talk about detective novels. And the plot in that one is indeed one of my favorites. 'Riveting,' you said?

steps.name: May
steps.text: I most certainly did! How does one even come up with such a twisty plot? Ooh, I swear my hair stood on ends as I read the final reveal!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm sure. It's a perfect cocktail of literary creativity and logical deduction that jabs the reader right in the psyche. Easily my favorite one in the series.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh——I see. It's so clear to me!

steps.name: May
steps.text: It was written in the first person, so... The murderer was actually the protag——mmffst. Mmffmm?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Fool! You can't just spoil the whole thing! Natalya hasn't read it yet!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Mmmmmpf!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Pfah——Haah! You almost killed me...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Nnng! I bit my tongue. That hurt. I understand not wanting spoilers, but that was way out of line, Istina!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Interesting. You really like your detective novels, eh, Anna? I don't usually see you so excited to talk about something.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh? R- really?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Really. In fact, I think you'll have to let me read one too. Since they're clearly so compelling.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You want to read too, Natalya? I never would have imagined. Every time I asked you before, you'd say the same thing: 'When I have time.'

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Huh. Is that right...?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: But when I see the two of you crowing on about these books, I can't help but want to join in.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: All right then. The more the merrier.

steps.name: May
steps.text: There really aren't many people here who can hold a conversation about great art... The Doctor reads, but finding time for a conversation is no simple task.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: The Doctor... Ah, you mean that one commander.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I see you're familiar, Natalya?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: I am. That one is quite a unique presence on this vessel. And I've had the pleasure of bearing witness to that particular commander's field operations.

steps.name: May
steps.text: It's too bad. There's some special meeting or some-such on today. I wanted to give the Doctor a biscuit.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm sure Hibiscus will make sure the Doctor gets a share.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Yes. Dr. Kal'tsit keeps a close eye, but it's clear that everyone is just as concerned about the Doctor.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: The medical staff, in particular. I went for a test recently and overheard several medics discussing adjustments to the Doctor's diet... I believe the confiscation of snacks was mentioned?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hahahaha. That's a fairly reasonable step, no?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy was moaning about that too. Honestly, what does that one eat every day?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Also, what was that about a 'test,' Natalya?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh, I would appreciate some discretion in this matter. I haven't made up my mind yet, but... it is why I came here today.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Now's not the time, actually. Let's come back to it another day.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: You'll know soon, Anna. In all likelihood.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: All right then. I won't pry.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ahem, let's get back to the matter at hand. Why don't we start Natalya off with the classics?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh, is that the matter at hand then?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hehe, it's an excellent opportunity to introduce a friend to your beloved hobby.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I wouldn't let this go so easily.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Ooh... you're positively oozing passion right now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But of course!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't underestimate the power of the detective novel. No matter the type, a masterwork carries a living soul within it.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Heh heh. That's an Annaism if I've ever heard one. But that doesn't make it any less true.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Reasoning out the plot of a novel is part of the fun, but the true draw of the detective genre goes much deeper.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Istina speaks the truth, but I have to say my favorite part is always when the detective unmasks the true culprit.

steps.name: May
steps.text: And if we're talking classics, we of course have to talk about 'that one,' eh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: 'That one?' Do you mean...?

steps.name: May
steps.text: 'That one!' Yes!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: May
steps.text: 'One truth prevails! The murderer is——You!'

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh, I know that one. It's a detective's catchphrase.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Righto. No matter how many times I hear it, it still gets my heart racing!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But in my opinion, it's after the culprit is found that the real thinking, the real interesting bit begins.

steps.name: May
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Allow me to answer your question with another question, May. Upon cornering the criminal, and after arriving at the truth, what is it the detective should do?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Should she announce the truth to everyone, securing a conviction?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Even when the truth is clear, the law may from time to time be an ineffective remedy. What then, can she do?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Does she allow this criminal to get away with his crimes? Or does she take the law into her own hands?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Such things happen in the real world too. With no simple solution.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: If I were her...

steps.name: May
steps.text: ...Hmm.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Did you just want to drop that one on us?

steps.name: May
steps.text: What are you even talking about, Istina? You've been acting off all day. Are you feeling alright?

steps.name: May
steps.text: ...No, no fever?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...I'm sorry?

steps.name: May
steps.text: A detective's duty is to uncover the truth. The rest is up to the police, of course. She can't play judge, jury, and executioner.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Every part of the justice system plays a role. The police, the courts, and detectives like us. Isn't that obvious?

steps.name: May
steps.text: What's that face now? Did I say something so shocking?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Of course I know a detective can't legally convict a criminal.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I just never expected to hear you talk sense...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hey now! What's that supposed to mean?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Nothing. Just talking to myself.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Now, given the world we live in, we've got a fair number of people who pass their days killing and killing. Murder may not seem a crime of particularly immediate concern, but we'll set that aside for the moment.

steps.name: May
steps.text: It remains our duty, as detectives, to seek out the truth and uphold the law to the best of our abilities.

steps.name: May
steps.text: We may not pass judgment. We may not go above the law. We may not exact our own justice.

steps.name: May
steps.text: To do harm to others, no matter how we may package it, is an immoral act. The character of such behavior is immutable.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Indeed. You're right...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Whether or not the crime is ever known to others, whether or not judgment is ever passed, the knowledge of the crime lives forever within the criminal.

steps.name: May
steps.text: And it is the detective who digs out that truth! Ah ha! Just saying things like that feels so stupendously cool!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The knowledge of the crime...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No matter the justification, regardless of whether or not it is known to the world, what's done is done.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And someday...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh my, our little chat here has turned rather dour.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Sorry. I shouldn't have brought it up.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh no, it was quite the enlightening discussion to witness. But on the rare occasion we meet again for afternoon tea, let's discuss something a bit lighter.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes. Good idea.

steps.name: May
steps.text: The tea's gone cold.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hm? Is that...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What is it, May? You stood up just to have something catch your eye?

steps.name: May
steps.text: It's, well, see for yourselves. What's that outside the window?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Hm? The window? Let me see.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Oh, it's... flying? And flying this way.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Looks like some sort of drone?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: A drone?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It is a drone... But what is it doing out here? Actually, I think it's caught on the rigging.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ah! Well, if it's attached to the landship, it can't be a threat, eh? Nothing to worry about then.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Upsies.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Are you mad?! Don't just go diving out windows!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hehe, gotcha——

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: May! Watch your footing!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Waaaah——

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Gasp*!
Anna!
Phew! Thank heaven it's you.
She slipped just like that.
Her body wafted back and forth, the breeze blowing her long hair, so clean it clashed with the scene around us. That stark contrast made it seem like the entire episode was nothing but a dream.
Pull me up, Anna.
I froze. Silent.
...Anna?
With a light touch, the dream slipped away.
No words. No sound. Just a few small marks on my fingertips.
...Anna, please, what are you doing?!
I just watched her fall.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: May! That was so reckless! Are you hurt?

steps.name: May
steps.text: It definitely hurts, but I'm alright. Nothing permanent.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, but there's a note taped to the drone!

steps.name: May
steps.text: And it's for you, Natalya.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Huh? For me?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: May...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Wow, what happened? You look like you've seen a ghost!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Are you sure? You're definitely not sick? I wouldn't think any less of you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Fool.

steps.name: May
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What kind of absolute moron would dive out a window and go hanging from the rigging just to get her hands on a mysterious drone?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: A woman with a brain would use a tool, or ask me to use my Arts!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Well I didn't think of that, okay?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Use your head next time!
Don't scare me like that. Idiot.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Give me your hand.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Eh? No need for that, I'm really okay.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You scratched your hand on the windowsill.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't play dumb with me. I see right through you. You have a terrible poker face.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Your eyes are way too sharp.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: As a 'junior detective,' keen powers of observation are a must, no?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ack.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, it's not a deep cut. We'll just wipe it clean, apply some disinfectant... and we're done.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But you'll still want to have a medic operator look at it, no matter how small the wound.

steps.name: May
steps.text: It's nothing serious. Don't get so worked up!

steps.name: May
steps.text: But thanks all the same. Hehe.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: The note is a summons from Silence.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Dr. Silence?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Yes, it's about the test I mentioned before.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: But it's kind of scary. How did Dr. Silence know I was here?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Anything's possible with drones, right? From Dr. Kal'tsit on down, the medics all have their ways...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: That's for sure.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Sorry, Anna, it seems I'm off to Medical.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No problem. It's clearly something important. Go take care of it.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Well, I'd better be on my way then too.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I've returned your book, and borrowed another. A complete success!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What's a complete success?

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Let's do this again soon.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: If all goes well, I'm looking forward to telling the whole Self-Governing Group the good news.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes. As am I.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Anna...

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Nothing. Forget it.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Until next time.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Toodle-oo~

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: 'The good news,' huh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Vika, tell me, what exactly will that good news be?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya, and Zima, or Sonya... if they can get along...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is such a thing possible? Yes, I think so too.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I have never forgotten about you. About what happened to you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Would you blame me, if I did? You would, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No? I know that's not true. I know you, Vika. And I know that's a lie. In fact, I know you can't speak at all.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've been with me for so long. You're still by my side today.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: One day, we must all come to terms...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...But not today. Not now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It seems... I am not strong enough. I still can't do it. Not yet.
